_doc: MANUAL price list for Shuk Ra'anana. The shuk is NOT covered by the price-transparency law (chains with 3+ branches only), so there is no automatic feed — prices here are entered by hand after a market visit. Produce only (fruit and veg); the shuk does not sell packaged staples. Each entry: name (Hebrew, as on the stall), price in shekels, unit ('kg' or 'item'), recorded date (YYYY-MM-DD). To refresh: visit the shuk, note the stall prices, update this file, commit and push — the daily snapshot cron does NOT touch this file.
